title: Added "Follow DCCP stream" feature to DCCP dissector
description:
This merge request adds a "Follow DCCP stream" feature to the DCCP dissector, like it is already available for TCP, UDP and SCTP. This includes the capability to easily filter for all packets of the same DCCP flow (e.g. "dccp.stream eq 0", etc.) like for UDP.

A packet capture of NetPerfMeter run with 10 DCCP flows is added for testing as well:
./test/captures/netperfmeter-dccp.pcapng.gz
